blurb: Guests play paintball or airsoft in a wooded outdoor environment with various game formats and structures like a castle and train cars. Paintball games last about 15 minutes each, with 8 to 12 games in a full day session. Private sessions require a minimum of 20 players and allow groups to play exclusively among themselves.
extraNote: Deposits are nonrefundable; no refunds or exchanges if fewer players show up · To postpone a reservation, notify at least 48 hours before start time to reschedule without losing deposit · Rain or shine play; rain checks issued if park closes due to weather, no cash refunds · Private session deposits due at least 7 days before date · If fewer than 20 players attend private session, operator may mix other players
